Hello Ferios investors!

Today we are happy to share with you that The Invisible Hand now has French language support.

[h3][b]A message from the developer[/b][/h3]
[i]Bonjour!

If economical viability was the sole reason to do things, life would be boring. We just had to see Will's awesome jokes translated to our own mother tongue.

So we took it upon ourselves and did it! We're glad to finally be able to give you the French version of The Invisible Hand!

Setting aside the grind that is transforming close to 50k words to even more than that (French is so verbose..), being able to infuse our own frog-eater cultural references in it was a lot of fun.

On espère que vous aimerez!

Ben (Power Struggle Games)[/i]

notes.title: The Family Office Update
notes.notes:
[h3]NOTHING SUCCEEDS LIKE SUCCESS.[/h3]

As a trader, you’ve amassed enough wealth for FERIOS that somebody in the Miller Family Office has decided to retain you as their personal financial advisor. Will you fail miserably, or will you be so successful that even more powerful and shadowy members of the family make you their golden goose instead?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/28daa2de775cdd13e84cf5c855e58b924c5fd43e.png[/img]
In this update to The Invisible Hand, explore a new and improved Endless Mode that will allow you to gradually control entire percentages of the global economy on behalf of the wealthiest people nobody has ever heard of.

[h3]MAY YOU COME TO THE ATTENTION OF THOSE IN POWER.[/h3]
With the Succession System, you’ll gradually earn the trust of wealthier and wealthier members of the Miller clan, progressively restarting the game with an increasingly prestigious group of sociopaths to impress - and unscrupulous new advantages to help you do it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/1aa152bccc55bcf86adf4967f1d5f878016edf18.png[/img]

[h3]MAY YOU LIVE IN INTERESTING TIMES.[/h3]
Explore the opportunity to see a less hazy and more human side of your fellow professionals. Pursue up-close and personal friendships with Ward, Corbin and the rest of the gang in thrilling relationship cutscenes such as ‘drinking until you pass out' and ‘glimpses of an unhappy home life’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/1ecf9c7e5e5aa0736c841931200135d97560639e.png[/img]

[h3]MAY YOU FIND WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING FOR.[/h3]
As your responsibilities and assets under management grow, your terminal will ignite with numbers of dizzying proportions - all of which serve the purpose of enabling your access to yet another set of even larger numbers. This then takes place again. And again. And again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/e5e42343d740293e1177e32783e5a8e9fa1db3e6.png[/img]

As an Endless Mode player, your options are immeasurable. Do you have what it takes to make the numbers so big that it forces us to patch the game to allow for even bigger numbers? Can you delay our future projects and ruin our lives for the sake of a pointless abstraction? Can you test the implied warranty of the word ‘endless’ for some indecipherable purpose? The choice is yours.

Of course, Endless Mode will be accessible to all players who purchase The Invisible Hand whether they begin by playing through the original campaign or not - just don’t say we didn’t warn you.

notes.title: March Board Update
notes.notes:
Hi there traders!

The past month has been hectic and we’ve been cooking up a ton of things that we can’t yet talk about but you can expect extremely cool announcements in April. As much as I want to purchase an island on credit to go live off-the-grid for a few years, we live in a society and THERE IS STILL WORK TO DO.

[b]Balancing[/b]

This one is quite hard to do - there’s as many ways to play as there are players and they all want to feel challenged yet satisfied with their performance. How dare they. Our patented trademarked exclusive in-house Trading Software can be quite complex for beginners, and striking the balance between delivering enough features to provide a satisfying gameplay experience at each moment of the competition while not overwhelming probationary analysts is delicate. 

We’ve added a Glossary to the interface so you can get a refresher on complex terms and features, worked on the overall difficulty and rhythm of competitions, and if that’s still not enough you can switch to Story Mode for a blissful and carefree experience if you lose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/86834546e83544f12b58a6f82dedaa496c17409e.png[/img]
[i]Is this the Dark Souls of trading games?[/i]

[b]Environment[/b]

We’ve been using the same flat skybox for years but we decided we needed something a little more 3D. Who wouldn’t want huge piles of concrete and glass as a view? It’s also a great way to contextualize what can happen if you fiddle with the economy a little too hard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/13c749258117ab5d0f0334f0bf820951ae763779.png[/img]
[i]This is fine.[/i]

notes.title: February Board Update
notes.notes:
Hi there traders!

After a busy January with the Steam Game Festival, where we didn’t find the time to update you all on development, here we are again. After all, “the past is in your head, the future is in your hands.”

[b]Story Mode[/b]
Have you heard that some people aren’t actually interested in making as much money as possible? They want to live a good life doing things they enjoy, helping their neighbours and cuddling puppies. This is a perfectly valid philosophy but maybe they should ask their banker what they think about it. 

FERIOS has a strong commitment to inclusivity and accessibility (our PR specialist told us to write this). You’ll be able to enjoy the game in Story Mode, where the company will offset your losses, and competition will be actively biased in your favor, so you can lay back and enjoy the show with zero worries about actually working.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/be2765bbba86ff8ff3bb30be18140e61962302b5.png[/img] 
[i]In Story Mode you can spend more time neatly organizing your desk[/i]

[b]Achievements[/b]
But there’s also another kind of people. People that want to make the most out of the cards they’re dealt. People who are ready to sacrifice everything to get their games to 100% completion so their Steam friends can see how committed they are. Those people are welcome too and we’re cooking up some challenges so they can show-off their skills and brag to their fellow gamer friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/a53dd56f6a85cdfd73da3cf085d8712449470922.png[/img]
[i]That’s a nice thing to have on your profile isn’t it[/i]

Thanks for tuning in, see you next month!

We'll be playing through The Invisible Hand, and showing off just what it looks like to be a mid-level stockbroker, pursuing wealth and success at the cost of everything else.... possibly even your freedom.

notes.title: December Board Update
notes.notes:
Hello and happy new year to our beloved shareholders. With the coming year, our primary goal is to reach new heights, for a successful 2021. And as we all know, a pillar of success is buying yachts and doing frivolous things on them, another key goal for 2021. 

[b]Ignorance is blissful but information is power[/b]
Far removed from the physical and mental concerns of the lower class, our moneyed friends occasionally gather in swell environments to network and discuss the matters of the masters, while consuming recreational substances. We wanted to integrate a representation of this fascinating ritual of sociological interest. But don’t think it’s all fun and games. Important information is shared and secret deals are made in those places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/4717eb3acc6f766c7c6ff8f18445b581045ca065.png[/img]
[i]When nothing goes right, go left.[/i]

[b]Funneling what’s trickling down[/b]
Capitalism has a tendency to favor those who are already established. Once you are rich enough, we’ll let you access a *re-distributive* feature of modern finance: dividends. You give money to a company, and they regularly give you a little less money in return. If you maintain your positions well, after some time, you’ll be out of work but you’ll still get paid just because you own those pieces of privatized power we call shares. This is trickle-down economics. You just have to make sure it stops trickling down at your level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/7c106021838b8a09d2a1621059a7f20e10eb825e.png[/img]
[i]If you made a cent for every manufactured bullet, well that’d just be bad cause war is not cool.[/i]

See you next month!

notes.title: November Board Update
notes.notes:
Howdy! We’re back here this month to humbly share our advancement with you, our [i]precious [/i]shareholders.

Here’s a detailed infographic of how things are going:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/8aadf5578ed679ffa34947a1f0313fa024db42e3.png[/img]

As you can see, things are going great. Someone with big influence said one day, “Network Marketing is the wave of the future”.

Last month we went hard on implementing content to make the game playable from start to finish. We’re almost there, and right now the balancing is so off it’s actually funny to watch the market behave in a way we, the actual developers of the game, didn’t anticipate. Fortunately our advanced computer experience will make it easy for us to refine this into a well-paced and satisfying experience, up to [i]industry standards[/i], by orienting the odds in your favour. We value our shared interests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/89b3638891aa6a31570c3bd561f26d5b9d9720f0.png[/img]
[i]You will experience relatively normal things in the game[/i]

We’re having fun implementing physically impossible character spawning to keep you on edge. Have you ever been scared by a coworker tapping on your shoulder while you’re focused on some [i]important work stuff[/i]? We’re working on including it. Life in the office has its ups and downs, but we’re working on narrative beats and systems so it’s more ups than downs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/c18be26de97e59eb53946cec6cc6b9f05961f17b.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=q8F6zS9I8PM;full][/previewyoutube]
Navigate your first term through conversations with your cabinet members, colleagues and family. It’s up to you to decide who you will trust, what you will sacrifice and where your priorities lie.

Will you reform the constitution, transforming the Republic into a brutal dictatorship or true democracy? Align yourself with the capitalist of communist superpowers? Prepare for potential military threats on the horizon? Address racial minorities, women’s rights, the ongoing recession, immigration and all the other challenges and opportunities presented to a world leader.

notes.title: October Board Update
notes.notes:
Hi there! Welcome to our first monthly developer update, known as the Board Update, to let you know how things are progressing on The Invisible Hand. 

For the past few months we've been working on content production, blending market mechanics and narration with the help of our masterfully crafted master script by [url=https://twitter.com/willoneill]Will O'Neill[/url] and music composed by [url=https://felixwatson.com.au/about]Felix Watson[/url].

This is complex work as we're giving players a lot of freedom to act in opposition to the narrative, and want them to feel seen, while not going down too many narrative branches before our endings. We're achieving this by creating small branches that are quickly resolved and put back on track of the main branch, storing information about players' choices that affect the ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139347/d9999d4e3b7ad5ae7d29749de322908c5670fc77.png[/img] [i]People can get angry if you don't do what you're told[/i]

In October, we worked on polish and bug fixes as development was slowed down due to health issues of our main developer, Ben. A round of playtest organized by one of our producers, Louis, brought a ton of good ideas. We decided to slow down the rhythm of the game a bit by making in-game days a bit longer. This is more work than it sounds like, as we had to rework timing for events in a lot of places. We’ve been reluctant to do this in the past because we liked having players feel pressured by time, but it was getting in the way of understanding and enjoying mechanics for a lot of players, so we caved to the lobbying.

Thanks for tuning into this Board Report, we appreciate the ongoing confidence and support of our cherished shareholders, and we assure you that together, we’ll make more money than you can imagine. See you next month!

notes.title: Devlog 2019
notes.notes:
Hey there! Here's a sneak peek on what's been done and what we will be working on in 2019.
Happy New Year !

[h1]Coworkers[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1ocsCn8.jpg[/img]
Don't they all look happy to be here?

Coworkers play an important part in the narrative and gameplay, and they now have more thoughts to share and dubious hint to dispense. 
We use Adobe Fuse CC to create them, which makes importing and animating them in Unity relatively easy. We still have to use custom import scripts to install all our character modules, such as the Dialogue module which has been improved a lot lately.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LXSevksF7hjnEXNwsO/giphy.gif[/img]  [img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1bLpa0dVSFrEXR4oJS/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Trading UI Rework[/h1]

Fitting the stock market/player information/interactions we need on player screens in an ergonomic, functional and aesthetic way is one of our greatest challenges for the development of the game.
The market gameplay was subject to a lot of improvements and new features in the last months, and now that it’s in an almost final state we’re still polishing the UI to improve the user experience.

Stay tuned as we’ll have things to show in the coming months!

[h1]Player immersion[/h1]

The other significant challenge we are facing is player immersion. We’ve had a lot of feedback where players didn’t feel they were making a difference in the game’s world through trading. 
As of now, most of our narrative triggers for the player’s action are long term and subtle, and we are going to work on delivering real time narrative elements reacting to how you play the markets. 

We already have some ideas, but that’s an area where feedback is very important, so as usual if you want to try the game in its current state or if you want to contribute let us know!

notes.title: Steam Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi there! 

We, our small two person studio Power Struggle Games, have been working on our first ever game for 3 years. We have been quietly working behind the scenes, and now we would like to share our development journey with you. 

The Invisible Hand puts you in the shoes of a mid-level stockbroker, experiencing their obsessive daily life as they pursue wealth and success at the cost of everything else… possibly even your freedom. 

Caught in the hamster wheel of a stock broking agency, your every day is a heady mix of high stakes decision making under pressure. Presented with profit targets by a boss who has no hesitation to sack you, you’ll need to engage in panic sales and timed events, lobby society groups to influence the stock market, and even undertake all-out majority share acquisitions, all while keeping social movements in check.

We sought out to make a game that was about the politics of work and money, exploring the way we produce and value things. We chose a stock market driven dystopia as the setting of our story, where you’ll be reaching for your tenth enhanced coffee before the working day is done. 

We are still early in development but you can follow the development progress right here on Steam, on [url=https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=57175]TIG forums[/url], or follow the [url=https://twitter.com/PowerStruggleG]Power Struggle Games twitter[/url]. 

If you are interested in the game and have questions, feel free to ask away. We will be monitoring the boards regularly, with some help from our friends at Fellow Traveller. We are working with their wonderful team to publish the game. 

Cheers, 
Benjamin and Nicolas
